name: Caiaphas
summary: The high priest in the year Jesus was crucified. He told the council it was better for one man to die for the people, and Jesus was brought before him after His arrest.

key_moments.title: Says One Man Should Die for the People
key_moments.description: The council worried about the miracles Jesus was doing. Caiaphas told them it was better for one man to die for the people than for the whole nation to perish, and from that day they planned to kill Jesus.

key_moments.title: Plots in His Palace to Kill Jesus
key_moments.description: The chief priests, scribes and elders gathered at the palace of Caiaphas the high priest. They planned to take Jesus by trickery and kill Him, but not during the feast.

key_moments.title: Puts Jesus on Trial
key_moments.description: Jesus was led to Caiaphas, where false witnesses spoke against Him. When Jesus said they would see the Son of man coming on the clouds, the high priest tore his clothes and called it blasphemy.

key_moments.title: Questioning Peter and John
key_moments.description: Caiaphas was among the rulers in Jerusalem who questioned Peter and John about healing a lame man. They told the apostles not to speak or teach in Jesus' name.
